dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Wow, I can't believe I'm holding the key to shaking up Mondstadt's entire wine industry in my own two hands... Wowzaa!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Thank you so much, {NICKNAME}! I'm gonna head back and start developing my new drinks right away!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wait, don't leave without me! I thought you were gonna let me be the taste tester!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Of course, hehe... Operation "eliminate drunkards" has just begun, and you, my friend, are my first test subject...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #And just like that, another problem solved! Looks like you've done it again, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Alcohol that doesn't make you drunk... If I'm able to develop something like that... I guess there really is a type of alcohol that I can get behind...
